_doc: Fiches des monstres : nom, description fidèle au sprite d'origine (anglais, pour le dessin de référence), objet tenu, archétype de mouvement. Les descriptions viennent de l'observation des 5 directions du repos (x8).

MTRO.description: A gaunt, lanky troll with rubbery olive-yellow (khaki yellow-green) skin covered in small warts. Extremely long thin arms that hang well below the knees, ending in long bony fingers with pale curved claws. Long thin legs with knobbly knees and large clawed feet with pale claws. Narrow bony torso with visible ribs and spine, almost no neck. Small head with a long pointed nose like a beak, a wide mouth with a long pink tongue hanging out, and a wild mane of dark olive spiky hair and quills sticking up from the top and back of the head. No clothes.

MUMB.description: A massive, very broad umber hulk covered in glossy dark teal and blackish-green chitin plates like a giant beetle. Huge rounded hunched back and shoulders, the head sunk low between the shoulders. Insect-like head with two big yellowish mandibles, four small glowing red eyes, and two thin antennae on top. Very thick powerful arms ending in three long dark hooked claws each. Short thick legs with clawed feet. No clothes.

MVAM.description: A gaunt, slightly hunched male vampire with pale silvery-grey skin and a bald head. He wears a silver-grey ribbed leather jerkin with a wide royal blue and gold embroidered collar, a brown leather tunic hanging to mid-thigh with a dark green cloth panel at the front, a royal blue sash at the waist, gold and brown bands around the knees and ankles, silver-grey leggings and grey boots. Long thin fingers with pointed nails. No cape.

MMIN.description: A mind flayer with smooth lilac-purple skin and an octopus-like head with four long tentacles hanging from the face over the chest, and blank eyes. A tall rigid golden-yellow fan-shaped collar rises behind the head. Orange-brown fitted jacket with wide golden pointed shoulder pads and dark red sleeves. From the waist down, a long dark navy-blue robe reaching the ground, decorated with swirling grey-white spiral patterns. Thin purple hands with long clawed fingers.

MIGO.description: A massive iron golem made of polished silver-grey metal with a chrome sheen, sculpted like a huge muscular man with smooth flowing iron plates. Very broad shoulders and chest, small bald head sunk between the shoulders, huge thick arms with big hands and thick fingers, a hanging iron loincloth plate at the waist, heavy thick legs with large blocky feet.

MGLC.description: A massive clay golem sculpted from rough brown earthen clay with darker cracks and finger marks. Huge hunched shoulders, small bald head with a heavy brow sunk between the shoulders, very long thick arms with big clenched fists, a dirty off-white cloth loincloth tied around the waist, thick legs with heavy feet.

MLIC.description: An undead lich with a dried, dark leathery skull-like face. He wears a tall slate-blue cap, a long ornate robe of orange-brown cloth embroidered with gold patterns, with wide pale blue-grey sleeves and a pale blue-grey hem, a thin white sash crossing the chest diagonally, a light grey belt, and pale blue-grey boots with cream wrappings at the shins. Thin bony hands.

MGIT.description: A gaunt githyanki warrior with yellowish-grey leathery skin, a narrow face with a long nose, and dark blue-black hair tied in a tall topknot crest. Large golden spiked pauldrons on both shoulders, dark grey-brown segmented leather armor on the torso, arms and legs, a long ochre cloth tabard hanging at the front and back from the belt, dark grey boots.

MSLY.en: the Slayer, the monstrous avatar of the god of murder
MSLY.description: The Slayer: a gaunt, emaciated demonic humanoid with dark crimson-red raw flesh, visible ribs and sinews. Dozens of long black-brown spikes and quills grow from the head, shoulders and back. Very long thin arms with long clawed fingers like talons, long thin legs with bird-like clawed feet. Small horned head with a fanged mouth. No clothes.

MSHD.description: A shadow fiend: a pitch-black, smoky humanoid demon with a glossy black body, two glowing red eyes, short spikes along the shoulders, arms and spine, long thin arms with long clawed fingers, digitigrade legs with clawed feet, and a long thin tail. No clothes.
